projectTitle: SMMA: A WordPress site for an architecture practice
project_haiku: SMMA needed a site that could show a building as a project, not a thumbnail. With TOKY, we built it on WordPress, with fields the marketing team can fill in and a catalog of the firm's work.
project_footer_CTA: Need a portfolio site your marketing team can add a project to? SMMA is that site.
pageSummary:
The job

SMMA is an architecture and engineering firm working in education, workplace, healthcare, and life sciences. The site had to present projects with some depth, and the people who win the work had to be able to publish a project without a developer. TOKY led the design, in Figma. Knectar built it.

What we built

The site is WordPress and Elementor, with Advanced Custom Fields for the project record. Blocks cover the pieces TOKY designed: a before-and-after of rendering and photograph, image and story, galleries, accordions, and quotes. HubSpot receives the forms. Gravity Forms handles gated downloads. SmashBalloon brings in Instagram. Tinify compresses images on the way in. Real Media Library keeps the files organized.

Outcomes

SMMA can add a project, a form, and a gallery. The page structure is the one TOKY drew, filled in by the firm.
